page0.text:
"Do you have something in mind, Tohsaka?"
I'm going to settle things with Kotomine.
Even if I don't have a chance of winning, I can't run away.
But if Tohsaka has a plan, I'll hear her out, no matter what it is.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-16:page0:1

page1.text:
"Unfortunately, I don't. But I'll give you a parting gift. It's meant for self-defense, but it's better than nothing."
Tohsaka reaches behind her and pulls out a single dagger.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-16:page1:1
